title: PhishletTemplateInput
description: Input form for the phishlet-oriented template generator. Purely structural — no attack payloads.

target_name.description: Operator label for the engagement target, e.g. 'acme-corp-sso'. Must not be a real hostname of an unauthorized third party.

login_paths.description: Relative paths observed for login/auth endpoints, e.g. '/login', '/oauth/authorize'.

cookie_names.description: Cookie *names* relevant to session establishment, e.g. 'session_id'. No values.
